records.title: res.cookie Max-Age and Expires directives that agree
records.implementation: maxAge (ms) is converted to expires and floored to seconds for Max-Age.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: res.cookie must not emit a Max-Age that contradicts a future Expires. A sub-second maxAge must not serialize Max-Age=0 alongside a future Expires; res.clearCookie (response.js:709-716) remains the only path that sets an immediate expiry.

records.title: Well-formed res.redirect body for any accepted status code
records.implementation: The body is built from statuses.message[status] via res.format.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: res.redirect must produce a well-formed body for any accepted status code. For a status with no statuses.message entry, the body and HTML <title> must not contain the literal string undefined.

records.title: Safe, well-defined grammar for res.jsonp callback names
records.implementation: The callback is filtered by /[^\[\]\w$.]/g then reflected into a text/javascript body guarded by typeof … === 'function'.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: res.jsonp callback names must be restricted to a safe, well-defined grammar. Only callback strings matching the intended grammar reach the body; member-access chains either are rejected or are proven safe by the guard. X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff is always set on jsonp responses (response.js:271,282).

records.title: RFC 7231 §3.1.1.1-conformant media-type parameter parsing in acceptParams
records.implementation: Hand-rolled scan over ;/= boundaries extracting q and params.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: acceptParams must parse media-type parameters per RFC 7231 §3.1.1.1. Quoted parameter values containing ; are not split mid-value; q is parsed and clamped to [0,1]; the splitIndex > endIndex recovery branch (utils.js:102-104) does not drop valid params.

records.title: Consistent charset handling across res.send body types and the res.set/res.type/res.json/res.jsonp surfaces
records.implementation: String send rewrites charset to utf-8 via setCharset; Buffer send preserves it; res.set/res.type inject charset via mime.contentType.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Charset handling must be consistent across res.send body types and res.set/res.type/res.json/res.jsonp surfaces. Per-site (Cartesian): UC-06.a a pre-set non-utf-8 charset sent as a string body must behave per the documented v5 rule (force utf-8) consistently; UC-06.b the same charset sent as a Buffer body must follow the same documented rule, or the divergence must be explicitly specified; UC-06.c res.set('Content-Type', …) charset injection (via mime.contentType) must agree with res.send's setCharset injection for the same input.

records.title: Non-empty, correct req.protocol scheme for every trusted X-Forwarded-Proto value
records.implementation: req.protocol getter comma-splits and trims the forwarded header; req.secure derives from it.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: req.protocol must yield a non-empty, correct scheme for every trusted X-Forwarded-Proto value. For header values "", ",", ", https", "https,", "http, https" with trust proxy enabled, req.protocol ∈ {http, https} and req.secure reflects the real scheme.

records.title: Consistent req.host/req.hostname/req.subdomains resolution for all trusted X-Forwarded-Host shapes
records.implementation: host selects/trims XFH then Host; hostname strips the port; subdomains splits on '.'.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: req.host/req.hostname/req.subdomains must resolve consistently for all trusted X-Forwarded-Host shapes. Per-site (UC-07.a/b/c): for trusted XFH values "a.com", ",a.com", "a.com,", "a.com:8080", "[::1]:8080", each of host/hostname/subdomains returns the value implied by the leading authority, never undefined for a syntactically present host.

records.title: Fail-fast settings compilation on invalid configuration
records.implementation: compileETag/compileQueryParser/compileTrust throw TypeError on unknown values at app.set time.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Settings compilation must fail fast on invalid configuration. Invalid values for etag/query parser/trust proxy settings throw a TypeError at app.set time, not at request time.

records.title: Per-bug writeup placement at quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md
records.implementation: Phase 5 TDD writeup generation writes one self-contained markdown writeup per confirmed bug.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Per-bug writeups are placed at quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md. Every confirmed BUG-<id> has a writeup at quality/writeups/BUG-<id>.md.

records.title: Fix-patch placement at quality/patches/BUG-<id>-fix.patch
records.implementation: Each confirmed bug with a fix carries a git-diff fix patch under quality/patches/.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Fix patches are placed at quality/patches/BUG-<id>-fix.patch. Fix patches are named quality/patches/BUG-<id>-fix.patch.

records.title: Regression-test patch placement at quality/patches/BUG-<id>-regression-test.patch
records.implementation: Each confirmed bug carries a git-diff regression-test patch under quality/patches/.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Regression-test patches are placed at quality/patches/BUG-<id>-regression-test.patch. Regression-test patches are named quality/patches/BUG-<id>-regression-test.patch.

records.title: Code-review output placement under quality/code_reviews/
records.implementation: Phase 3 code-review pass outputs are written under quality/code_reviews/.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Code review output is placed at quality/code_reviews/. Code review output files live under quality/code_reviews/.

records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Spec audit outputs (auditor reports + triage) are placed at quality/spec_audits/. Spec audit auditor reports and triage outputs live under quality/spec_audits/.

records.implementation: Machine-readable phase results are written under quality/results/.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Sidecar JSON results (tdd-results.json, integration-results.json, recheck-results.json) are placed at quality/results/. tdd-results.json, integration-results.json, and recheck-results.json live under quality/results/.

records.title: Mechanical-verification artifact placement under quality/mechanical/
records.implementation: When dispatch/enumeration contracts exist, the orchestrator + case witnesses live under quality/mechanical/.
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: Mechanical-verification artifacts (verify.py + *_cases.txt) are placed at quality/mechanical/. verify.py and *_cases.txt artifacts live under quality/mechanical/ (NOT APPLICABLE this run — Express lib/ has no closed-constant dispatch tables).

records.title: Prohibition on quality/workspace/<name>/ in favor of top-level quality/<name>/
records.implementation: The Phase 6 gate check_no_workspace_dir fails any run with a quality/workspace/ tree present (populated OR empty).
records.conditions_of_satisfaction: quality/workspace/<name>/ is forbidden — top-level quality/<name>/ is the only canonical layout. No quality/workspace/ directory exists at any point in the run; all artifacts use top-level quality/<name>/ paths.
